    Extract Estimated Parameters and States from Rolling SSM Results

    extract_params_df.Rd

    Iterates through the results of a rolling State-Space estimation (pseudo out-of-sample) and collapses the estimated parameters and the final latent state into a single, tidy dataframe.

    extract_params_df(results_list)

    Arguments

    results_list

    A nested list, typically the output from new_forecasting_okun_ssm. Each element of the list must contain target_date, params (a named list of economic scale parameters), and states (the Kalman Filter output containing the state vector r).

    Value

    A tibble or data.frame containing:

    quarter

    The date of the vantage point (estimation end date).

    natural_rate

    The final filtered estimate of the structural trend (\(\rho_T\)).

    ...

    All estimated model parameters (e.g., beta1, beta2, sigma_unemp_rate).

    Details

    For each vantage point (estimation window), the function:

    1. Converts the list of mapped economic parameters (\(\beta\), \(\sigma\), etc.) into a row.

    2. Extracts the final estimated value of the latent state (\(\rho_T\)), which represents the Natural Rate of unemployment at that specific point in time.

    3. Appends the specific quarter to identify the estimation vintage.

    This creates a "Vantage Point Dataframe" where each row represents the model's worldview at a specific date in history.

    See also

    loglik_ssm for the origin of the params and states objects.

    [rolling_est_okun_ssm()]
